newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Sinophil to hike capital to 20 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Sinophil to hike capital to 20 bln pesos.

text.p: Oil explorer Sinophil Corp said on Tuesday its board approved the increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from two billion.
The board has also decided to change the par value of its shares to one peso from one centavo.
A special stockholders' meeting has been set on March 10 to take up the recommendations of its board, the company said.
The company also said it has raised three billion pesos from a private placement to fund its planned investments for the year.
Sinophil shares have been rising on the Philippine Stock Exchange on rumours it will be a holding company.
